companies.name: Broadcom Inc.
companies.company_summary: Broadcom designs and sells semiconductor solutions for data center networking and storage, including Ethernet switches, adapters, and storage controllers, serving cloud and enterprise data centers.

companies.name: Cisco Systems
companies.company_summary: Cisco Systems designs and sells networking hardware, software, and services for data centers, enabling connectivity and security for enterprise and cloud providers. Its products include switches, routers, and security appliances. Cisco focuses on network infrastructure that supports data center operations.

companies.name: Dell Technologies
companies.company_summary: Dell Technologies designs and manufactures a broad portfolio of data center infrastructure, including servers, storage systems, and networking gear, serving enterprise and cloud providers globally. Its products are used in on-premises and cloud data centers. Dell provides integrated solutions for compute and storage.

companies.name: Eaton Corporation plc
companies.company_summary: Eaton is a power management company that designs and manufactures electrical systems and components for data centers, including uninterruptible power supplies, power distribution units, and switchgear, to ensure reliable and efficient power delivery.

companies.name: Hewlett Packard Enterprise
companies.company_summary: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) designs and manufactures a broad portfolio of servers, storage, networking, and software for enterprise data centers and hybrid cloud environments. It serves enterprises and service providers globally, offering solutions for compute, storage, and network infrastructure. HPE also provides services and support for these systems.

companies.name: Lenovo Group Limited
companies.company_summary: Lenovo designs and manufactures a broad portfolio of data center infrastructure, including servers, storage, and networking, serving enterprise and cloud providers globally. Its products are used in various data center environments. Lenovo focuses on providing reliable and scalable hardware solutions.

companies.name: NVIDIA Corporation
companies.company_summary: NVIDIA designs and sells GPUs, systems, and software for accelerated computing, widely used in data centers for AI, machine learning, and high-performance computing.

companies.name: NetApp
companies.company_summary: NetApp provides intelligent data management solutions, including flash storage systems and software, for enterprise data centers and cloud environments. Its products help organizations manage and store data efficiently. NetApp focuses on storage and data management technologies.

companies.name: Pure Storage
companies.company_summary: Pure Storage designs and sells all-flash data storage hardware and software for enterprise data centers, offering high-performance arrays and cloud-based management. Its products are designed for high performance and reliability. Pure Storage focuses on flash storage solutions.

companies.name: Rittal GmbH & Co. KG
companies.company_summary: Rittal manufactures industrial enclosures, IT racks, and power distribution systems for data centers and industrial applications. They provide physical infrastructure solutions for server and networking equipment.

companies.name: Samsung Electronics
companies.company_summary: Samsung Electronics manufactures memory and storage solutions, including DRAM, NAND flash, and SSDs, for data center servers and storage systems. It also produces servers and other IT equipment for enterprise and cloud data centers.

companies.name: Vertiv Group Corp
companies.company_summary: Vertiv designs and manufactures power, cooling, and IT infrastructure solutions for data centers and edge computing. The company serves enterprises, cloud providers, and colocation facilities globally.

companies.name: Lianjer
companies.company_summary: Lianjer manufactures server racks and enclosures for data center and networking applications, offering a range of standard and customizable rack solutions.

companies.name: Juniper Networks
companies.company_summary: Juniper Networks designs and sells high-performance networking equipment and software, including switches, routers, and security solutions, used in data center and cloud environments. Its products provide connectivity and security for data center networks. Juniper focuses on network infrastructure.

companies.name: Micron Technology, Inc.
companies.company_summary: Micron Technology is a leading manufacturer of memory and storage solutions, including DRAM, NAND flash, and solid-state drives. Its products are essential components in data center servers and storage systems, serving enterprise and cloud customers.

companies.name: Western Digital Corporation
companies.company_summary: Western Digital designs and manufactures data storage solutions, including hard disk drives and solid-state drives, for enterprise and data center applications.

companies.name: Seagate Technology Holdings plc
companies.company_summary: Seagate designs and manufactures data storage solutions, including hard disk drives and solid-state drives, serving enterprise and data center customers with high-capacity storage products. Its products are used for data storage in data centers. Seagate focuses on storage devices.

companies.name: Deutsche Telekom AG
companies.company_summary: Deutsche Telekom is a global telecommunications provider that offers data center services including cloud, colocation, and managed hosting to enterprises and public sector organizations.

companies.name: Siemens
companies.company_summary: Siemens offers a range of products and solutions for data center infrastructure, including building automation, power distribution, and data center infrastructure management software, serving enterprise and colocation data centers globally.

companies.name: Celestica
companies.company_summary: Celestica is a global manufacturer of electronics and hardware solutions, providing design, manufacturing, and supply chain services for data center infrastructure including servers, storage, and networking equipment.

companies.name: Emerson Network Power
companies.company_summary: Emerson Network Power, now part of Vertiv, designs and manufactures power and cooling infrastructure for data centers, ensuring reliability and efficiency.

companies.name: Palo Alto Networks
companies.company_summary: Palo Alto Networks is a cybersecurity company that offers advanced firewalls and cloud-based security solutions to protect data center and enterprise networks from cyber threats.

companies.name: NextDC
companies.company_summary: NextDC operates a network of data centers across Australia, offering colocation, interconnection, and cloud services to enterprises and government. They provide secure, scalable infrastructure for mission-critical IT operations.

companies.name: Sabey Data Centers
companies.company_summary: Sabey Data Centers designs, builds, and operates multi-tenant data centers, offering colocation services to enterprise and government clients. They focus on scalable, reliable infrastructure.

companies.name: Panasonic Corporation
companies.company_summary: Panasonic is a diversified electronics manufacturer that provides IT equipment and cooling solutions for data center environments, serving enterprise and industrial customers.

companies.name: Honeywell International Inc.
companies.company_summary: Honeywell provides building automation, fire, and security solutions for data centers, helping to ensure operational efficiency and safety.

companies.name: Stulz GmbH
companies.company_summary: Stulz GmbH designs and manufactures precision cooling solutions for data centers and other critical applications, offering energy-efficient climate control systems.

companies.name: Asetek
companies.company_summary: Asetek designs and manufactures liquid cooling solutions for data centers and gaming PCs, focusing on energy efficiency and performance. Their products are used by server OEMs and data center operators to manage heat in high-density environments.

companies.name: Iceotope Technologies Limited
companies.company_summary: Iceotope provides precision liquid cooling systems for data centers, enabling efficient thermal management for high-performance computing. Their solutions are used by data center operators and server manufacturers to reduce energy consumption and improve cooling efficiency.

companies.name: Plug Power Inc.
companies.company_summary: Plug Power designs and manufactures hydrogen fuel cell systems and hydrogen generation equipment, offering backup power solutions for data centers and other critical infrastructure.

companies.name: Wärtsilä
companies.company_summary: Wärtsilä is a global technology company that provides advanced power generation and energy storage solutions, including for data centers, ensuring reliable and efficient power supply.

companies.name: Google
companies.company_summary: Google operates a global network of data centers and offers cloud computing services, including infrastructure, platform, and productivity applications, to businesses and organizations worldwide.

companies.name: Arista Networks
companies.company_summary: Arista Networks designs and sells high-performance Ethernet switches and network software for data centers and cloud computing environments. Their products are used by large enterprises and cloud providers to build scalable, reliable networks.

companies.name: SK hynix
companies.company_summary: SK hynix is a semiconductor supplier that manufactures memory products such as DRAM and NAND flash, along with solid-state drives, used in data center servers and storage systems.

companies.name: CyrusOne
companies.company_summary: CyrusOne operates a global network of data centers, offering colocation and interconnection services to enterprises and cloud providers. They provide secure, scalable data center infrastructure to support mission-critical IT operations.

companies.name: Telehouse
companies.company_summary: Telehouse operates a global network of carrier-neutral data centers, offering colocation, managed hosting, and connectivity services to enterprises and telecommunications providers. It supports the data center market by providing physical infrastructure and network access.

companies.name: AirTrunk
companies.company_summary: AirTrunk designs, builds, and operates hyperscale data centers in the Asia-Pacific region, serving cloud providers and large enterprises. They offer scalable, energy-efficient data center solutions to support digital infrastructure needs.

companies.name: Stack Infrastructure
companies.company_summary: Stack Infrastructure designs, builds, and operates wholesale data centers, offering colocation and build-to-suit solutions for hyperscale and enterprise customers. They provide scalable data center capacity across North America and Europe.

companies.name: T5 Data Centers
companies.company_summary: T5 Data Centers develops and operates data centers, offering colocation and build-to-suit solutions for enterprise and hyperscale customers. They provide scalable, secure facilities with power and cooling infrastructure.

companies.name: Airedale International Air Conditioning Ltd
companies.company_summary: Airedale designs and manufactures precision cooling solutions for data centers and other critical environments, offering energy-efficient systems and services.

companies.name: CoolIT Systems
companies.company_summary: CoolIT Systems designs and manufactures direct liquid cooling solutions for data center servers and high-performance computing, enabling efficient thermal management for high-density deployments.

companies.name: Alibaba Cloud
companies.company_summary: Alibaba Cloud is a cloud computing subsidiary of Alibaba Group, offering a comprehensive suite of global cloud services including elastic computing, data storage, and networking solutions. It operates data centers worldwide, serving enterprises and developers with scalable infrastructure.

companies.name: Tencent Cloud
companies.company_summary: Tencent Cloud is the cloud computing arm of Tencent Holdings, offering a comprehensive suite of cloud services including computing, storage, networking, and AI solutions to enterprises globally.

companies.name: Sharp Corporation
companies.company_summary: Sharp Corporation is a global manufacturer of electronic products, including displays, solar panels, and components. In the data center market, Sharp provides visual display solutions and solar energy products for sustainable infrastructure.

companies.name: Intel Corporation
companies.company_summary: Intel designs and manufactures processors, accelerators, and other silicon for data center servers, enabling compute for cloud, enterprise, and AI workloads.

companies.name: Mitsubishi Electric Corporation
companies.company_summary: Mitsubishi Electric manufactures power and cooling infrastructure for data centers, including UPS systems and precision air conditioners, serving enterprise and colocation facilities globally.

companies.name: KDDI
companies.company_summary: KDDI is a Japanese telecommunications and IT services company that offers data center and cloud services to enterprises, supporting their digital transformation.

companies.name: GE Power
companies.company_summary: GE Power is a division of General Electric focused on power generation and energy management. It offers products and services for the energy sector, including solutions for data center power infrastructure. The company's domain suggests a global presence in power systems.

companies.name: Fujitsu Limited
companies.company_summary: Fujitsu is a Japanese multinational IT equipment and services company. It produces a wide range of hardware including servers, storage systems, and networking gear used in data centers. The company also provides IT services and solutions.

companies.name: Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd.
companies.company_summary: Huawei is a leading global provider of ICT infrastructure and smart devices. It offers data center solutions including servers, storage, networking, and cloud services. The company is known for its extensive R&D and global operations.

companies.name: Hon Hai Precision Industry Co., Ltd.
companies.company_summary: Hon Hai Precision Industry, also known as Foxconn, is a major electronics contract manufacturer. It produces servers, networking equipment, and other components for data center OEMs. The company is a key player in the global supply chain.

companies.name: Chindata Group
companies.company_summary: Chindata Group is a leading provider of hyperscale data center solutions in Asia-Pacific. It focuses on building and operating data centers for large internet and cloud companies. The company emphasizes energy efficiency and sustainable operations.

companies.name: Qualcomm Incorporated
companies.company_summary: Qualcomm is a global leader in wireless technology and semiconductor design. It provides chips for mobile devices and increasingly for data center applications, including networking and edge computing. The company's innovations support advanced data processing.

companies.name: China Unicom
companies.company_summary: China Unicom is one of China's major state-owned telecommunications operators. It offers a range of services including data center hosting, cloud computing, and network services. The company operates numerous data centers across China.

companies.name: Interxion
companies.company_summary: Interxion is a European provider of carrier-neutral colocation data center services. It offers secure, high-availability data centers for cloud, content, and enterprise customers. The company has a strong presence in major European cities.

companies.name: Hitachi, Ltd.
companies.company_summary: Hitachi is a global conglomerate with a significant presence in IT and data center systems, offering a range of hardware and services. It manufactures servers, storage systems, and other data center equipment.

companies.name: Quanta Computer Inc.
companies.company_summary: Quanta Computer is a major Taiwanese OEM that produces servers, storage systems, and networking equipment for data centers. It supplies to leading cloud and technology companies.

companies.name: Cray
companies.company_summary: Cray specializes in supercomputers and high-performance computing systems used in data centers for complex simulations and data processing. It is known for its advanced computing technology.

companies.name: Saft
companies.company_summary: Saft is a battery manufacturer that provides energy storage solutions, including batteries for data center backup power systems. Its products ensure reliability and continuity of operations.

companies.name: Force10 Networks
companies.company_summary: Force10 Networks was a provider of high-performance Ethernet switching and routing solutions for data centers. It focused on scalable and resilient networking infrastructure.

companies.name: Silicon Graphics International Corp.
companies.company_summary: Silicon Graphics International (SGI) was a manufacturer of high-performance servers, storage, and visualization systems for data centers and HPC environments. It provided solutions for demanding workloads.

companies.name: Viawest
companies.company_summary: Viawest was a provider of data center services including colocation, managed hosting, and cloud solutions. It operated multiple data centers and offered connectivity and security services.
